name: Plaza Lienzo
summary: Plaza Lienzo is a popular community shopping center in Mexicali's Rivera district, serving local residents with a convenient mix of retail, dining, and services. With nearly 4,000 reviews and a 4.4-star rating, it has established itself as a trusted destination for everyday shopping needs along Calzada Manuel Gómez Morín.
demographics: Plaza Lienzo serves the growing residential communities of Rivera in Mexicali, attracting middle-income families and young professionals who represent the area's expanding population. The trade area draws from nearby neighborhoods with a mix of established households and first-time homebuyers seeking convenient shopping options. Typical visitors include families with children shopping for everyday needs, as well as working adults looking for dining and entertainment options close to home. The center benefits from Mexicali's border city dynamics, serving both local residents and some cross-border shoppers seeking Mexican retail and dining experiences.
description: Plaza Lienzo is a modern community shopping center located in the Rivera district of Mexicali, Baja California, strategically positioned along Calzada Manuel Gómez Morín. This well-regarded retail destination has earned a strong reputation among local residents, reflected in its impressive 4.4-star rating from nearly 4,000 Google reviews. The center serves as a convenient one-stop shopping hub for the surrounding residential communities, offering a diverse mix of retail stores, dining establishments, and service providers. With extended operating hours from 8:00 AM until midnight, Plaza Lienzo accommodates the busy schedules of working families and provides a welcoming environment for evening shopping and entertainment. The center's contemporary design and tenant mix cater to the everyday needs of Mexicali's growing Rivera neighborhood, making it an essential part of the local commercial landscape.
